args.title: Use application config for public URL in notification email links
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use config.publicUrl instead of process.env.PUBLIC_URL (falling back to localhost) when building BASE_URL, so that password reset email links point to the configured public URL rather than localhost in production environments.
